create_gripper_instance: create a Robotiq2FingerGripper instance connected to a serial port with configurable device ID, stroke, and baud rate
activate_and_deactivate_gripper: activate or deactivate the Robotiq 2-finger gripper by setting the rACT command variable and updating the command
move_gripper_to_position: move the gripper to a target position with specified velocity and grip force using the goto method
read_gripper_status: read the gripper status including position, current, fault code, and object detection flags via getStatus
check_gripper_state: check if the gripper is ready, moving, stopped, reset, or has detected an object using state query methods
